label: LoRA training memory and timing probe, 2-clip subset, 8 steps
_note: seconds_per_step is tqdm's rate over the optimiser steps only. It excludes pipeline load and the one-off VAE pre-encode of the whole dataset, which the job pays once; budget a real run as load + pre-encode + steps x rate.

_phases.note: 614 s from job start to the first optimiser step with 2 clips. Dominated by loading the 13.8 GB checkpoint (T5-XXL in 2 shards) from Ocean, not by the VAE pre-encode. A 16-clip run pays the same load plus 8x the per-clip encode.

_measurement_note: seconds_per_step_steady excludes the first step (14 s, warmup/allocator) and the final save. seconds_per_step_tqdm_final is tqdm's average over all 8 steps including the save, so it is the pessimistic figure. The schedule below is budgeted at 4.0 s.
_outcome: Training itself succeeded and the adapter was written. The job still exited 1, in the post-save block, where upstream calls pipe.load_lora_weights(output_dir) with no weight_name, invalid under HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1. Patched locally; see the LOCAL PATCH comment in third_party/diffusers_v0.36.0/train_cogvideox_lora.py.
memory_verdict: Peak 20.16 GiB of 45.0 GiB usable. Fits with large headroom; gradient checkpointing and VAE tiling/slicing were both on.
